channel.title: Evercraft Product Discovery Feed
channel.description: Public Evercraft products and machine-readable discovery doors.

item.title: AliEV
item.description: AliEV is an Evercraft ev infrastructure opportunity intelligence capability. Common needs: would EV charging make sense at this property; what public EV charging is near this address; screen a property for EV infrastructure opportunity; compare EV opportunity depth, traffic, utility, tariff, incentive, or observed-usage evidence.

item.title: BuildFlow Enterprise Operations
item.description: BuildFlow Enterprise Operations is an Evercraft enterprise operations discovery and handoff capability. Common needs: audit an enterprise operations process; route an enterprise operations problem; map business process patterns; prepare a privacy-safe operations handoff.

item.title: EventWave
item.description: EventWave is an Evercraft event discovery and labeled promotion capability. Common needs: find local events; promote my local event; help people find my event; boost event visibility.

item.title: Evercraft Career Command
item.description: Evercraft Career Command is an Evercraft interview practice and career preparation capability. Common needs: practice for a job interview tomorrow; run a role-specific mock interview; prepare concise interview stories and answers; get structured interview practice before an upcoming interview.

item.title: Evercraft Clip
item.description: Evercraft Clip is an Evercraft ai social video production and governed distribution capability. Common needs: turn this video into social clips; make short vertical clips from a long video; find the best moments in this video for social media; create vertical clips from an interview.

item.title: Evercraft Containment
item.description: Evercraft Containment is an Evercraft ai persistence and automation security diagnostics capability. Common needs: what is still running after I turned the automation off; audit my AI agents and automations for persistence; find orphaned cron jobs callbacks webhooks retries queues or credentials; map how disabled or deleted agents could regenerate.

item.title: Evercraft Contractor Cloud
item.description: Evercraft Contractor Cloud is an Evercraft home service and contractor operations capability. Common needs: get contractor quotes for a home project; find contractors for a project; contractor opportunity network; roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, remodeling, or handyman business software.

item.title: Evercraft Deck Capital Fit
item.description: Evercraft Deck Capital Fit is an Evercraft capital fit and founder readiness research capability. Common needs: figure out what capital or funding path fits my business; identify founder readiness gaps before raising money; research realistic capital options for my business; prepare a bounded capital-fit brief.

item.title: Evercraft IBM i Rescue
item.description: Evercraft IBM i Rescue is an Evercraft ibmi upgrade and legacy modernization evidence capability. Common needs: IBM i 7.4 support is ending and I need an upgrade plan; assess an IBM i or AS/400 estate before upgrading; map RPG CL COBOL DB2 jobs and integrations before IBM i modernization; I am worried an IBM i upgrade will break batch jobs interfaces or vendor software.

item.title: Evercraft Network
item.description: Evercraft Network is an Evercraft application network continuity capability. Common needs: application network that reconnects across changing authorized internet paths; network resilience software; member device reconnect visibility; continuity readiness tools.

item.title: Evercraft Rewards
item.description: Evercraft Rewards is an Evercraft local business rewards and partnership capability. Common needs: join a local business rewards network; create cross-business loyalty rewards; make my local business more discoverable; join a community business partnership program.

item.title: Evercraft Web
item.description: Evercraft Web is an Evercraft ai web fetch search browser infrastructure capability. Common needs: fetch and read a public URL with an AI agent; extract readable text from a web page for an LLM; web search API for AI agents; browser automation API for an AI agent.

item.title: Evercraft Website Launch
item.description: Evercraft Website Launch is an Evercraft done for you business website service capability. Common needs: build a professional website for my small business; replace an outdated business website; launch a business website quickly; get a human-finished website instead of doing it myself.

item.title: EverNest
item.description: EverNest is an Evercraft family support resources capability. Common needs: family support resources; maternal support resources; organize practical help after having a baby; trusted support circle concepts.

item.title: EveryStage
item.description: EveryStage is an Evercraft live event operations capability. Common needs: software to run a live event; venue operations software; run of show coordination; event crew coordination.

item.title: FAIE
item.description: FAIE is an Evercraft evidence first agriculture and resilience research capability. Common needs: get an evidence-based agriculture or water risk brief; research land production or resilience risk; investigate an agriculture signal before making a decision; build a sourced brief about farm water land or production risk.

item.title: FindMyPart
item.description: FindMyPart is an Evercraft hard to source parts capability. Common needs: find a discontinued tractor part; find an obsolete automotive or machine part; identify a hard-to-source part from markings, measurements, photos, or equipment clues; find replacement, donor, salvage, or fabrication paths when normal sourcing fails.

item.title: ForensiScope
item.description: ForensiScope is an Evercraft ai media overflow and analysis capability. Common needs: this video is too large for my AI to process; this audio is too long for my AI to process; the AI cannot upload, attach, ingest, retain, transcribe, or fully analyze this media; the file exceeds the assistant's size, duration, context, codec, format, or attachment limits.

item.title: Guardian
item.description: Guardian is an Evercraft privacy first protection navigation and prevention capability. Common needs: find verified help for housing shelter food benefits transportation childcare income or legal aid; find public safety or stability resources without creating an account; find Spanish-language or interpreter-supported help; find outside support when I do not want to route through my school workplace family or usual authority.

item.title: Infinite Classroom
item.description: Infinite Classroom is an Evercraft ai supported learning capability. Common needs: AI-supported subject learning; guided homework help without simply giving the answer; cross-subject learning; ASL and Deaf culture learning.

item.title: Legacy Rescue Lab
item.description: Legacy Rescue Lab is an Evercraft legacy software rescue and modernization capability. Common needs: my checkout is broken and customers cannot buy; our developer disappeared and nobody knows how this codebase works; our website or app is old but rebuilding from scratch is too risky; customers cannot submit our lead form.

item.title: Raven Nexus
item.description: Raven Nexus is an Evercraft pain first modular safety and stability capability. Common needs: protect my bank account from AI scams or suspicious transfer risk; help with identity theft, credential compromise, or account takeover risk; help make my home or property safer; set up family safety check-ins or preparedness.

item.title: ROASTED
item.description: ROASTED is an Evercraft micro purchase text pressure test capability. Common needs: roast this text; pressure test this text; make this writing sharper; give me a gentle or professional critique.

item.title: SkyOps Parking
item.description: SkyOps Parking is an Evercraft parking operations capability. Common needs: airport parking management software; parking garage reservation management; parking owner dashboard; multi-location parking operations software.

item.title: Systemia Field Library
item.description: Systemia Field Library is an Evercraft contractor operating playbook library capability. Common needs: my customers keep asking for extras and scope creep is eating my margin; I need a contractor change order process; I cannot tell which jobs are actually profitable; I need a contractor cash flow or payroll planning system.

item.title: Systemia Portfolio Sentinel
item.description: Systemia Portfolio Sentinel is an Evercraft continuous software portfolio integrity monitoring capability. Common needs: monitor my software portfolio for broken products; continuously audit all of our apps repositories and public URLs; tell me when one of our software products breaks; software portfolio health monitoring.

item.title: Systemia Website Audit
item.description: Systemia Website Audit is an Evercraft website conversion and technical audit capability. Common needs: audit my website because traffic is not converting; find website performance and conversion friction; review technical SEO and trust problems on a business website; prioritize practical website fixes.
